name: Global Distribution Request 1
definition: Provides information about the global distribution.

PreadviceIndicator.name: Preadvice Indicator
PreadviceIndicator.definition: Indicates wether is message is an advice or pre-advice.

OptionNumber.name: Option Number
OptionNumber.definition: Number identifying the available corporate action options.

OptionType.name: Option Type
OptionType.definition: Specifies the corporate action options available to the account owner.

RecordDate.name: Record Date
RecordDate.definition: Date on which the holders of securities are/will be recorded for the income being paid or for entitlement to the rights or offer/privilege.

PaymentDate.name: Payment Date
PaymentDate.definition: Date on which securities/cash will be paid.

SecuritiesMovement.name: Securities Movement
SecuritiesMovement.definition: Provides information about the securities movement.

CashMovement.name: Cash Movement
CashMovement.definition: Provides information about the cash movement.

MovementRule.definition: At least one occurrence of either CashMovement or SecuritiesMovement must be present. Both may be present.
